hook: "📁 30 scroll-stopping Meta ads formats worth stealing right now"
idea: 30 stealable Meta formats in a tree — UGC Unboxing lands in the Bonus bucket, signaling it's a supporting format, not a headliner.
sequencing: Bonus bucket: UGC Unboxing, fake podcast, AI avatar, text convo, news.
formatting: ASCII folder-tree: 30 formats in 7 buckets; UGC Unboxing sits in the Bonus bucket. 105 bookmarks.
why_it_works: The tree's bucketing implies a hierarchy — bonus = nice-to-have. That framing itself is the insight: unboxing supports, it doesn't carry.
what_to_steal: File LC's unboxing/packing content under a 'bonus/evergreen' bucket in the creative library — always-on filler, not hero creative.

sequencing: Note: each type can be created differently.

why_it_works: Naming it as a type makes it briefable — creators know exactly what's expected.

hook: "If I took over your stuck ad account today, here's the exact order I'd change things to find a winner:" — takeover fantasy + exact order.
cta: none explicit — 'launch all of it in a fresh ad set' is the action.
idea: Unstick an ad account in priority order: new avatar → new creative style (AI UGC, animation, unboxing, reaction, native) → curiosity text hook → uncommon location → new VO style → combos → repackage messaging into 3 formats.
sequencing: Hook: the takeover promise — exact order to find a winner.
Step 2: new creative style — unboxing among five.
Step 3: curiosity-driven text hook, not benefit-driven.
Step 5: new voiceover style (talking head + B-roll).
Steps 6-7: avatar x format and avatar x hook combos.
Steps 8-9 + launch: same message x 3 formats, same avatar x 3 hooks, fresh ad set in main CBO.
formatting: Numbered 9-step turnaround playbook for a stuck ad account. Operator-to-operator tone.
why_it_works: 'Exact order' removes decision fatigue — a stuck buyer gets a sequence, not options. Avatar-before-style is the non-obvious prioritization that earns trust.
what_to_steal: The testing priority order for LC's creative sprints: avatar first, then style (unboxing = one of five style bets), then hook — and unboxing's inclusion in the style list confirms it as a default diversification bet for any stuck LC angle.

hook: "I built a 7 figure ecom brand at 24... and most of the day it's just me, sitting by myself in my room." — success + loneliness contrast.
idea: Ecom founders feel disconnected from the physical business (numbers on a screen) — walking the warehouse and seeing pickers/packers working because of one idea is surreal and grounding.
sequencing: Hook: 7-figure brand at 24, alone in a room.
The disconnect: ecom = numbers on a screen.
The realization: hundreds of strangers — farmers, drivers, packers — because of an idea.
The kicker: net worth stuck in pallets of ingredients.
Close: 'a pretty surreal thing to think about.'
formatting: Founder essay with a warehouse photo: short paragraphs, emotional beats ('surreal thing to think about'). Vulnerable-operator voice.
why_it_works: Success-loneliness is a vulnerable founder emotion rarely voiced — it earns trust. The warehouse walk converts abstract scale into human faces, which is inherently moving.
what_to_steal: The warehouse/packing-floor walk as LC founder content: Jay walking LC's fulfillment, showing the hands packing orders — it humanizes scale and makes '30k-50k orders/month' tangible. The 'numbers on a screen vs physical business' tension is the emotional engine.

hook: "10 winning AI UGC styles you can test on your brand right now:"

sequencing: Hook: 10 winning AI UGC styles to test now.
Recipes 6-10 incl. unboxing: package in frame, unwrap, texture details, short verdict.
formatting: Folder-tree list: 10 AI UGC styles × 3 sub-bullets each; unboxing recipe included.

what_to_steal: The unboxing recipe as LC's AI-unboxing prompt structure: package in frame → unwrap → macro texture shots → first try-on → one-line verdict. Directly generatable — LC's packing-order content can be AI-produced.
